entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element that indicates the reason why an EMM request from the UE is rejected by the network. It is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length.

entities.name: EMM cause IEI
entities.description: EMM cause information element identifier field located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Cause value
entities.description: EMM cause value field located in bits 8-1 of octet 2, containing the specific rejection reason code.

entities.name: Protocol error, unspecified
entities.description: Default treatment for any unrecognized cause value received by either mobile station or network, mapped to binary value 0110 1111.

entities.name: IMSI unknown in HSS
entities.description: EMM cause value 00000010 indicating the IMSI is unknown in the HSS.

entities.name: Illegal UE
entities.description: EMM cause value 00000011 indicating the UE is illegal.

entities.name: Redirection to 5GCN required
entities.description: EMM cause value 00011111 indicating redirection to 5GCN is required.

relations.description: EMM cause information element contains the EMM cause IEI identifier field.
EMM cause information element contains the cause value field.
Cause value field is guarded by the protocol error unspecified condition for unrecognized values.
Cause value field can be guarded by the IMSI unknown in HSS condition.
Cause value field can be guarded by the illegal UE condition.
Cause value field can be guarded by the redirection to 5GCN required condition.
